q: In cross 1, which feature is dominant?
Tall: all the offspring were tall.
Calculate the ratio of tall to short in cross 2.
Explain the 3 : 1 ratio, using the alleles T and t.
Parents are Tt × Tt. Offspring: TT, Tt, Tt, tt, so 3 tall : 1 short.
Use cross 3 to work out the genotype of the unknown tall parent. Explain.
About 1 : 1 tall to short, so the tall parent was Tt: half its gametes carry t, which with t from the short parent gives tt (short).
